'''International relations'''
*[[Syria and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[Syrian transitional government]] confirms their cooperation with the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] to purge [[nuclear material]]s at a hidden facility following a report by ''[[Axios (website)|Axios]]'' on such plan after an agreement between [[Israel]], Syria, and the [[United States]]. Conversely, Israel threatens to bombard the site again if the materials remain, and to prevent access to the site. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Hungarian presidential election]]
**Former [[Curia of Hungary|Supreme Court]] president [[András Baka]] is elected as [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[President of Hungary|president]] through a [[supermajority]] and is scheduled to take office on 19 August. He ran [[Uncontested election|uncontested]] as the [[Tisza Party]]'s candidate, as neither [[Fidesz]] nor its partner [[Christian Democratic People's Party (Hungary)|KNDP]] nominated a candidate. [https://www.reuters.com/world/hungary-parliament-elects-former-supreme-court-head-andras-baka-president-2026-08-11/ (Reuters)]
